sources.summary: Two of the world's largest companies are heading to court over claims of trade secret theft. Apple alleges ex-employees took key Apple secrets and technologies to OpenAI. In responding, OpenAI claims this is based on false truths and misinformation, but even if it wasn't, it doesn't want Apple's trade secrets anyway.

sources.title_original: VPN provider built a script to block Microsoft's hidden GDID tracking on Windows —  Windscribe's "deGDID" erases existing identifiers and blocks new ones from being created
sources.summary: You can run the deGDID script on your computer to delete cached GDID keys and prevent Microsoft's servers from minting new ones in the background. The firewall you put up with this script will break certain Microsoft services and features, however, but you can always reverse it.

stories.title: Microsoft wants the next-gen Xbox Helix to play every Xbox game ever made as it urges publishers to opt in — New report also claims Xbox 360 games coming to PC soon

sources.title: Microsoft wants the next-gen Xbox Helix to play every Xbox game ever made as it urges publishers to opt in — New report also claims Xbox 360 games coming to PC soon
sources.title_en: Microsoft wants the next-gen Xbox Helix to play every Xbox game ever made as it urges publishers to opt in — New report also claims Xbox 360 games coming to PC soon
sources.title_original: Microsoft wants the next-gen Xbox Helix to play every Xbox game ever made as it urges publishers to opt in — New report also claims Xbox 360 games coming to PC soon
sources.summary: The upcoming Xbox Helix is starting to feel more like a PC than any console before, and Microsoft's latest efforts to unite all Xbox generations under one roof, according to a new leaked memo, seem to signal that very explicitly.
sources.summary_zh: 即将推出的 Xbox Helix 开始感觉比以前的任何游戏机都更像一台 PC，而根据一份新泄露的备忘录，微软将所有 Xbox 世代统一在一个屋檐下的最新努力似乎非常明确地表明了这一点。

stories.title: Microsoft quietly purges 32GB of RAM recommendations from its website — company reels from the effects of the memory shortage as it released 8GB base models for Surface laptops this year

sources.title: Microsoft quietly purges 32GB of RAM recommendations from its website — company reels from the effects of the memory shortage as it released 8GB base models for Surface laptops this year
sources.title_en: Microsoft quietly purges 32GB of RAM recommendations from its website — company reels from the effects of the memory shortage as it released 8GB base models for Surface laptops this year
sources.title_original: Microsoft quietly purges 32GB of RAM recommendations from its website — company reels from the effects of the memory shortage as it released 8GB base models for Surface laptops this year
sources.summary: Microsoft once recommended 32GB of RAM as a future-proof "no worries" upgrade for gamers, but it seems that it wants you to forget that it ever gave that suggestion. That's because laptop manufacturers, including Microsoft itself, has once again started selling models with a base configuration of 8GB of RAM as companies memory prices skyrocket out of control.
sources.summary_zh: 微软曾经推荐 32GB RAM 作为面向游戏玩家的面向未来的“无忧”升级，但它似乎希望你忘记它曾经给出过这样的建议。这是因为随着各公司内存价格飙升失控，包括微软本身在内的笔记本电脑制造商再次开始销售基本配置为 8GB RAM 的型号。
